in_marathi.name: Bhuneshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhuneshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhuneshwar is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: Bhuh (Earth) and Ishwar (Lord). This name signifies the supreme lord of the earth, revered in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Bhuneshwar
